environment.name: woodegg/remotexapp v0.13.0; isolated build-host live acceptance

scenarios.reason: Boot recovery used private boot-marker simulation, not a host reboot.
Only GitHub publication authorized; sandbox deployment belongs to the sandbox project.

liveAcceptance.execution: All component gates from scripts/test-release-candidate.sh passed against the same untouched hosted archive. The first aggregate run stopped at a browser test-adapter failure; remaining gates were completed serially as separate invocations, not claimed as one successful aggregate run.

failedAttempts.problem: Headless Chrome/CDP timeouts on build host in both accepted RC.3 baseline and stable artifact.
failedAttempts.disposition: Use Chrome under Xvfb via a temporary launcher. Browser arguments changed only in test environment; no release bytes changed. Exact headless failure root cause not claimed.

failedAttempts.problem: Initial Xvfb shell launcher left Chrome alive, reusing the fixed debugging port and stale Kate page during the KWrite upgrade probe.
failedAttempts.disposition: Replace temporary launcher with process-group signal forwarding and cleanup; stop identified test-owned browser trees; rerun upgrade suite from a fresh fixture: passed.

failedAttempts.problem: Initial disposable-UID wrapper path was inaccessible.
failedAttempts.disposition: Make only temporary browser-launcher directory traversable and pass its PATH through the user-home fixture sudo boundary; fresh tests passed.

limitations: Human acceptance applies to RC.3 bytes, recorded separately; no second interactive UAT on the clean stable artifact is claimed.
Local browser gates used headed Chrome under Xvfb rather than headless mode due to reproduced host failures.
Disposable LightView testing uses the documented build-container WebKit sandbox exception; production sandbox support is not certified here.
Native Ubuntu 26.04/Qt6 certification, audio and multi-server coordination are outside this train.
All Tabs suspended can lose runtime keepalive; six-second leadership and five-minute silent-interest retention remain best effort.
Temporary fixture paths are local diagnostics, not portable public attachments; gate outcomes and qualifications are retained in this record.
Publication did not modify local deployments or sandboxes.
